# aperture Provider

Terraform provider for Aperture by Tailscale. Authentication is by Tailscale identity at the network layer — the caller must be on the tailnet with the admin role granted in Aperture's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aperture = {
      source  = "langri-sha/aperture"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

provider "aperture" {
  # Full base URL of the Aperture admin API including the /aperture
  # path prefix. Auth is by Tailscale identity at the network layer,
  # so the caller must be on the tailnet with the admin role.
  endpoint = "http://ai.tail-scale.ts.net/aperture"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Full base URL of the Aperture admin API including the /aperture path prefix, e.g. https://ai.<tailnet>.ts.net/aperture.
